purpose: Optimize both lambda and unknown mean mu using Gaussian mean-adjusted REML; compare to fixed-mu profile likelihood and training-only forecast-shrinkage

methods.joint_reml_continuous: GLS reference mean reestimated at each lambda, Gaussian REML removes mean direction, bounded log penalty search
methods.joint_reml_grid: same corrected unknown-mean REML but predeclared 15 normalized smoothness values
methods.fixed_zero_continuous: Gaussian fixed-mu profile likelihood at mu=0, same scalar optimizer
methods.plugin_sample_continuous: Gaussian fixed-mu profile likelihood with raw mean third difference estimated from training
methods.plugin_global_ols_continuous: Gaussian fixed-mu profile likelihood with global cubic OLS training reference
methods.shrink_tscv: penalty from full-history joint REML, alpha in [0,0.5,1] selected via inner rolling-origin forecast validation (lambda and mu reestimated per inner fold)

source_reuse: Read archived Experiment005 clean/noisy trials for synthetic and Experiment004 official FHWA selected positions for real; never regenerate original data

validation.synthetic: known finite third difference jerk of clean historical position and known clean future position
validation.real: future camera-observed position only; no ground truth for physical jerk
validation.leakage_protection: all inner-fold REML estimates re-fit on prefix only; outer test future observations inaccessible during parameter estimation
validation.inferential_scope: synthetic scenario-stratified independent-trial bootstrap; real resampling of five coarse recording blocks is exploratory only
